source_text: Συνέδησε δὲ ὁ μακάριος βαπτιστὴς τῇ τοῦ πνεύματος σημασίᾳ τὴν τοῦ πυρὸς ἐνέργειαν καὶ σημασίαν, οὐκ ἐν πυρὶ πάντως βαπτι σθήσεσθαι λέγων ἡμᾶς διὰ Χριστοῦ, ἀλλὰ τὴν τοῦ πνεύματος ἐνέρ γειαν τὴν ζωοποιὸν διὰ τῆς τοῦ πυρὸς σημασίας σημαίνων.
pass_a_gloss: And the blessed Baptist bound together with the of the spirit signification the of the fire energy and signification, not in fire altogether to-be-baptized saying us through Christ, but the of the spirit life-giving energy through the of the fire signification signifying.
pass_b_english: The blessed Baptist joins the Spirit’s meaning with fire’s energy and meaning. He is not saying we will be baptized in fire itself through Christ, but marking the Spirit’s life-giving energy by the figure of fire.

choices.why: Fire figures Spirit’s energy, not literal fire-baptism.
